First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Adventure Cycling Saturday Morning Ride group ride

A 20–30 mile Saturday loop from a southeast Denver-area shop. The pace adjusts to who shows up and nobody gets dropped. Cancelled below 35°F or in rain and snow; the shop posts cancellations on Facebook.
